newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed slightly down by 0.18 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 460.59 points, down from 461.43 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 462,753 dinars against 4.41 million dinars over the previous session.

Societe Tunisienne de Banque fell 0.96 dinar to 15.01 dinars with 3,121 shares changing hands. Banque du Sud slid 0.7 dinar to 22.67. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie was down 0.5 dinar to 30 dinars. BTEI bank eased 0.18 dinar to 22.
Airline Tunis Air declined 0.14 dinar to 22.36 dinars with the exchange of 4,831 shares.
Palm Beach Hotels rose 0.26 dinar to 9.88 dinars.
